text:
Lina P.: heads up — were hosting two external creators for a lunchtime interview at 12:30. one guest needs wheelchair-accessible seating near the mic. can we reserve the corner table by the big window?
Sam (People Ops): noted. we can mark the table as accessible. @Frontdesk Bot can you flag the lobby seating? :reserved: 
Frontdesk Bot: Accessibility seating reserved: Corner Table A (by big window). Temporary badge template: `visitor-access-v1.pdf`. Please upload guest list to `visitor-uploads/` for printing.
Marcus T.: quick mail note: two packages arrived this morning both labeled "Redwood Swag" for Lina. one is actually a locked prototype (serial PR-009). courier left them both at mailroom. dont open the locked one without security.
Lina P.: right — that locked box is prototype mics for the pod. Security approved storage in safe B but we need a sign-out sheet.
Jules (Facilities): i can pick up the prototype at 12:00 and transfer to safe B. i'll bring the sign-out clipboard. who will be the point person to sign?
Sam (People Ops): Lina will sign for it. @Marcus T. please add a bright sticker `PROTOTYPE - DO NOT OPEN` and update the logs.
Marcus T.: done — sticker applied and photo uploaded to `mail-photos/3105551111.jpg`. 
Frontdesk Bot: Delivery log updated. Oversized item note added for "Lina P.". Reminder: max temp badges per print: 8.
Lina P.: also, can we have one extra headset sanitized and ready for the mic? guest mentioned sensitivity to noise.
Jules (Facilities): we have a spare headset labeled `SND-01` in AV cupboard. i'll sanitize and leave at the table at 12:15.
Sam (People Ops): seat poll: corner table reserved for 2 external guests + host. react with :hand: if you plan to sit nearby and can help escort guests from lobby.
Marcus T.: i'll escort them and sign the prototype paperwork at 12:05.
Lina P.: guest list uploaded as `podcast_guests_20260318.csv`. badges requested with pronouns.
Frontdesk Bot: Badges printed using `visitor-access-v1.pdf` at 12:10. 3 badges ready in lobby tray.
Sam (People Ops): checklist: 1) guest list uploaded, 2) accessible table reserved, 3) prototype labeled and moved to safe B, 4) sign-out sheet ready, 5) headset sanitized, 6) badges printed. ping if anything else.
Lina P.: perfect, thanks everyone. see you at 12:30. :wave:
